item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud kyi 'phrul 'khor lag khrid
item.coloph: zhang zhung snyan rgyud 'phrul 'khor rim pa 'di ni/ dpon rgyal btsan pos stod lugs 'khrul zhig drug dang / smad lugs grub chen lnga las yang ston dam pa 'bum rje dang*/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du rim par brgyud pa dge'o//
